Title: [LSJ] Cards costing X, where X is an element of what set?

Messages.Author: vermillian
Messages.Body:
That is can I pick X to be negative?

That is, can I play hidden strength, burn -1 blood, to prevent zero
damage (with an optional press in the superior?).

Thanks. It came up in our local playgroup a while back, and I can't
seem to find an answer. My only thoughts on not being allowed would be
burning -1 blood.

~SV

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
vermillian wrote:
>
> That is can I pick X to be negative?

No. Costs can be zero. Costs cannot be negative.

> That is, can I play hidden strength, burn -1 blood, to prevent zero
> damage (with an optional press in the superior?).

No.

> Thanks. It came up in our local playgroup a while back, and I can't
> seem to find an answer. My only thoughts on not being allowed would be
> burning -1 blood.

Correct.

Ok, here the thing...

Lightning Reflexes
Cardtype: Combat

Cost: 1 blood

Discipline: Celerity

[cel] Additional strike.
[CEL] This vampire may burn X blood to gain X additional strikes.

From the text, it seems you'll have to burn 5 blood to get only 4

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On 16 Jan 2003 18:44:49 -0800, Kula...@yahoo.com (Kulaid) wrote:

>Lightning Reflexes
>Cardtype: Combat
>Cost: 1 blood
>Discipline: Celerity
>[cel] Additional strike.
>[CEL] This vampire may burn X blood to gain X additional strikes.

>From the text, it seems you'll have to burn 5 blood to get only 4
>additional strikes? Or would you get 5 additional strikes?

You burn and pay X+1 blood to gain X additional strikes.
In your example 5 blood is removed from the vampire playing the card
to gain 4 additional strikes.

Nine rounds in ten, Blur is a better choice.

Carpe noctem.
